## Bottom line

A biography of the sitting Assemblyman. His education and Assembly election check out. The housing claim takes personal credit for an outcome Long Island officials of both parties fought for together.

1. Degrees and the 2020 election are confirmed.
2. Hochul's 2023 zoning override was dropped after bipartisan Long Island opposition; the Democratic-led Legislature's leaders pulled it from the budget.
